title: AB Summary
description: Emitted once, when the FSM executor finishes a run that collected any ab_comparison results (FEAT-1822), reporting the run-level aggregate.

run_id.description: Run-scoped identity, stable across a run (including pause/resume). Stamped by FSMExecutor._emit()-routed events (ENH-3345) and by every parallel.* emitter (ENH-3346); required on all parallel.* events, optional elsewhere.

loop.description: Loop name, stamped on every FSMExecutor._emit()-routed event (ENH-3345). Not required for the same reason as run_id.

harness_pass_rate.description: Fraction of items where the harness arm passed (0-1)

baseline_pass_rate.description: Fraction of items where the baseline arm passed (0-1)

item_count.description: Number of items included in the summary
